passages.text:
Dear Meral,
I'm going to try to take notes on a Google Doc to facilitate immediate sharing/distribution. Even if I can't get the hotel wifi
to work, my cellphone hotspot should.
I suggest we set up a single set of blank notes docs in a folder somewhere on the Google Drive (DRG Center? ACTF?)
Do you have time to do that before 2:30, or do you want me to do that?
Cheers,
Blair
